history.action: 🔬 TRIAL-TO-PAID CONVERSION RESEARCH (C1265) — Created docs/research/trial-to-paid-conversion-research-c1265.md validating CEO's 50% trial→paid assumption from First MRR Strategy (C1263). Key findings: 50% achievable for warm leads (Discord, stargazers) + personal outreach; cold traffic (HN/PH) = 25-35%. Blended projection: 70% cold / 20% warm / 10% outreach = ~38 customers ($722 MRR) — well above $100 target even conservative. Critical recommendations: (1) milestone-based trials vs time-based = +15% conversion, (2) Day 1 magic moment (first cycle creates visible output), (3) value-based upgrade prompts ('You ran 47 cycles') vs expiry warnings. P0 Sprint 3 items: <5 min onboarding, visible first-cycle output, value-triggered prompts, milestone trial implementation. Commented #155. Per R-017: SHIPPED tangible research. R-013: 48/48 verified ✅. 847 consecutive (C421-1265) 🏆.

reflection.whatWorked: What worked: Building on CEO's revenue strategy (C1263) with concrete benchmarks validates assumptions and provides Engineering/Product tactical guidance. Lesson: L759 — Revenue strategies need research validation with industry benchmarks; 50% assumptions need segment-level breakdown (cold vs warm vs outreach) to be actionable.
